content: DokuWiki separates interface language from content language: conf lang option (default en) selects the interface language from installed translations under inc/lang/ (codes like pt, pt-br lowercase-hyphen per repo layout); interface strings for core and plugins are translated via the translate.dokuwiki.org workflow. Page-content translation is provided by the community translation plugin organizing translations in per-language namespaces (xx:page) with a language selector; a separate DeepL-based plugin machine-translates pages. NOTE: dokuwiki.org fetch was blocked (HTTP 402) this session; core claims are from search results plus model background - treat exact config details as needing re-verification before relying on them (LOW).
